non-blocking: the seeded-row double decides run scoping with `scoped = "run_id:$run_id" in cypher.replace(" ", "")`, which recognises one literal predicate spelling only. A semantically equivalent correct rewrite of the production statement (for example `WHERE c.run_id = $run_id`) would leave `scoped` false, make the double count every run's rows, and turn all five new tests red while the code under test was right. It errs loudly rather than silently, so it does not weaken the guard, but it binds the tests to the statement's exact text.
